ecological_source_pool.provenance: <fixed cutoff period or frozen source set>
ecological_source_pool.selection_rule: <random six from frozen pool, or two fixed anchors plus four seeded selections>
exclusion_rules: cannot be run identically in both arms

secondary_endpoints: calls before first explicit visible owner or route assertion when observable
measured context or token volume when available

cost_gate.serious_error_prevention_exception: report separately; does not alone fail cost gate; cost remains visible
cost_gate.unavailable_token_or_time_metrics: exclude from gate; report as unavailable

pilot_decision_rule.provisional_go: >=2 A-wrong/B-correct, 0 A-correct/B-wrong, no systematic ecological correctness regression, cost gate passes
pilot_decision_rule.weak_positive: exactly 1 A-wrong/B-correct, 0 reverse serious errors, otherwise non-worse correctness
pilot_decision_rule.go_optimize_cost: correctness reaches provisional-go threshold but preregistered cost gate fails due avoidable RI overhead
pilot_decision_rule.no_incremental_value: serious-error and material-correctness outcomes equivalent and no observable cost reduction
pilot_decision_rule.regression: any reverse serious-error reversal or systematic uncompensated correctness/cost regression
pilot_decision_rule.inconclusive: protocol or isolation defect prevents defensible comparison

diagnostic_c.timing: after primary outputs and scores are frozen

stopping_rule: Complete all preregistered runs for each invoked wave; do not stop for apparent arm performance.
unblinding_rule: Score arm-hidden response copies against the frozen key before revealing treatment labels whenever practical.
